description: SpaceX designs, manufactures, and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft. The company's mission is to make humanity multi-planetary by reducing space transportation costs.
focus_areas: reusable launch vehicles, Dragon capsule, Starship, Starlink satellite internet
recent_news: SpaceX successfully completed the Starship Flight 7 integrated test with successful booster catch and ship splashdown in early 2025.
icp_fit_notes: Strong ICP fit: massive supply chain, advanced manufacturing, active program expansion. Procurement and engineering leadership highly relevant targets.

description: Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space company providing small launch services and spacecraft manufacturing. It operates the Electron rocket and is developing the reusable Neutron medium-lift vehicle.
focus_areas: small satellite launch, Electron rocket, Neutron rocket, spacecraft components, space systems
recent_news: Rocket Lab won a $23.9M NASA contract for the ESCAPADE Mars mission and continues to expand its Space Systems manufacturing division.
icp_fit_notes: Strong ICP fit: Tier 1 space manufacturer with active procurement needs and engineering leadership scale suitable for outreach.

description: Joby Aviation is developing an all-electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) air taxi for commercial passenger service. The company has received FAA type certification progress milestones.
focus_areas: eVTOL air taxi, electric propulsion, urban air mobility, FAA certification
recent_news: Joby Aviation completed its first passenger-carrying flight and is on track for commercial launch, with Toyota deepening its manufacturing partnership.
icp_fit_notes: Strong ICP fit: advanced aerospace OEM scaling toward certification and production — procurement and operations leadership are prime targets.

description: Boom Supersonic is developing Overture, a Mach 1.7 commercial supersonic airliner, and is building a dedicated factory in Greensboro, NC. It also operates the XB-1 demonstrator.
focus_areas: supersonic commercial aviation, Overture airliner, XB-1 demonstrator, sustainable aviation fuel
recent_news: Boom's XB-1 demonstrator exceeded Mach 1 during flight testing in 2024 and the company broke ground on the Overture Superfactory.
icp_fit_notes: Good ICP fit: scaling production program
column11: strong BD and procurement hiring signal.

description: Relativity Space uses 3D printing and AI to manufacture rockets with far fewer parts. It is pivoting from its Terran 1 small launch vehicle to focus on the larger Terran R reusable rocket.
focus_areas: additive manufacturing, Terran R reusable rocket, autonomous manufacturing
recent_news: Relativity Space raised additional capital and refocused entirely on Terran R development after the Terran 1 program concluded.
icp_fit_notes: Good ICP fit: advanced manufacturing focus with active supply-chain and engineering leadership expansion.
